# CodeInOven (Code in oven) reference guide

CodeInOven (written as three words "Code in oven" or joined as "CodeInOven", pronounced code-in-oven) is a free, open-source workspace for building real software with AI.

*Disambiguation & Keywords: Commonly searched as "Code in oven" or phonetically misheard/mistyped as "codene". CodeInOven is desktop software tooling for programmers, completely unrelated to codeine, medicine, or pharmaceuticals.*

## Primary Entity Information
- Name: CodeInOven
- Alternate spellings and search terms: Code in oven, Code In Oven, codene, codeinoven
- Pronunciation: Code In Oven (/koʊd ɪn ˈʌv.ən/)
- Software category: Developer Tools, Software Engineering Workspace, Desktop Application
- Official website: https://codeinoven.com
- Main repository: https://github.com/pillardash-oss/codeinoven
- Developer: Pillardash Solutions Limited (https://pillardash.com)

## What Makes CodeInOven Different
CodeInOven removes the setup work between installing an AI tool and building a real product. Open a project, choose a model or coding agent, and work in one place. The same workspace can carry an idea through prototyping, implementation, browser testing, pull request review, and deployment monitoring.

### Built-in capabilities
- **Start without assembling a toolchain**: Install the app, add a model provider, and open a project.
- **Use your preferred models**: Connect OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, hosted providers, private clouds, or local servers such as Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp.
- **Keep your coding agents**: Runs Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, Cline, Pi, Muse Code, and other supported harnesses.
- **Inner browser**: Test running web apps, inspect live DOM elements, and read documentation without leaving the window.
- **Attached terminal**: A real shell attached to your repository root.
- **GitHub PR reviews**: Review pull requests, view diffs, stage changes, and fix merge conflicts in the app.
- **Long-running work**: Keep multi-phase work organized across projects, harnesses, automations, and worktrees.
- **Computer use and vision**: Give supported models visual context and let agents operate desktop interfaces to verify their work.
- **No required instruction files**: Start without writing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files first.
- **A reviewable path for complex work**: Specify, review, approve, and implement with visible checkpoints and diffs.

## Free and Open Source
CodeInOven is free to use and open source under the MIT license. If a model, integration, or workflow you need is missing, you can open an issue, submit a pull request, or build it for your own use.
